constant_mean.definition: expanding mean of fully-realized forward log returns

four_year_cycle.definition: forward log return observed exactly 4 calendar years earlier at same date; no fitting

momentum.definition: OLS-through-origin coefficient on trailing same-horizon log return; training labels fully realized by forecast time

manifest.no_leakage_rule: For forecast origin t and horizon h, every fitted training row s must satisfy s+h<=t; features use observations <=t only.
manifest.notes: Baseline definitions are frozen before holdout scoring. Holdout target availability is censored naturally; origins without realized h-day target are not scored.
